_comment: Copy this to profile.json and fill in your own values. profile.json is gitignored,
so nothing personal is ever committed. Everything that used to be hardcoded in
prepare.py, prompt.md, run.sh and watchlist.json now reads from here.

search.size_rule: The hard floor is a hard minimum, not a preference. Confirmed-smaller units are excluded and logged. Units with no published square footage are reported separately as size-unconfirmed, never silently dropped and never estimated as fact.

qualifying._comment: Used to flag listings you cannot clear on your own income, and to explain why. Set annual_income to 0 to disable this entirely.

tenant_context._comment: Free text spliced into the agent's context block at runtime. This is where anything personal belongs: it lands only in data/, which is gitignored. Leave empty if you do not want the agent to know anything about you.

paths._comment: Leave output_root null to default to $HOME/Desktop/Claude Work Flows/NYC Apartment Watch.

schedule._comment: Informational only. The actual schedule lives in the launchd plist.
